Headquartered in the bustling economic hub of Ningbo, Zhejiang, **GRAND GROUP CORPORATION** stands as a premier enterprise in the global chemical industry. Strategically located on the 13th floor of Pacific Plaza at No. 555 Jingjia Road, our company benefits from the dynamic commercial environment and unparalleled logistical advantages of one of China’s most vital and historic port cities. This prime location provides us with seamless access to global shipping routes, enabling us to efficiently bridge domestic manufacturing excellence with international market demands, and ensuring highly responsive supply chain solutions for our worldwide clientele.

As an industry-leading chemical company, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION is committed to delivering a comprehensive and diverse portfolio of high-quality chemical products and raw materials. Our extensive expertise spans across research, development, production, and global distribution, allowing us to cater to a multitude of complex sectors, including industrial manufacturing, agriculture, specialty chemicals, and consumer goods. We pride ourselves on maintaining rigorous, state-of-the-art quality control systems and adhering closely to the highest international industry standards, ensuring that every product we deliver meets the exact specifications and strict safety requirements of our partners.

Beyond pure product excellence, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION is deeply invested in innovation and sustainable development. We are consistently exploring future-forward chemical solutions that minimize environmental impact while maximizing industrial efficiency and performance. By fostering a corporate culture of continuous improvement, technological advancement, and unwavering customer-centric service, we strive to build long-lasting, mutually beneficial relationships. Whether you are seeking bulk industrial materials or specialized chemical formulations, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION remains your trusted, innovative, and reliable partner in the ever-evolving global market.
